note: Floating screen: it is drawn through a portal into the page body and placed against the window, so the reference is the whole default 1280x800 window on the app's backdrop and every box is in window coordinates. A Project's memory files (stock-ui/memory): the notes agents write for each other and for the person, listed, opened, edited, created and deleted; opened from the project's menu in the sidebar. Props are `MemoryScreenProps`: `projectId`, `name`, `onClose`, and `list()`, `get(file)`, `save(file, text, baseRevision?)`, `remove(file, revision)` and `setEnabled?(enabled)` which the core answers. The harness answers from the fixture: `index` is the `MemoryState` that `list` resolves (null: no answer), `texts` is each file's `{entry, text}` for `get`, `saved` and `removed` are what a write resolves (`conflict: true` is the core refusing a stale revision), `loading` makes the list never answer, and `noToggle` leaves out `setEnabled` (a core that cannot turn memory off). The times are written 'now', '5m ago', '3h ago', '2d ago' from the clock, which the harness holds at the fixed instant 1800000000000 ms so the picture does not change with the day; each file's `updatedAt` is that instant less its age. The shell is the stock `Dialog` (30 rem wide at most 92% of the window, 16 px of padding, the `dialog` screen); a delete asks first through the stock `ConfirmDialog` drawn over it (the `confirm` screen). Opening a file, New file, Back and Delete are the screen's own state, reached with `steps`.
